brief: Inspect intake and exhaust louvres for blockage, checking that obstructions do not exceed one quarter of the free area before the forecast heat event as outlined in SOP-015. Additionally, review open work orders against the asset to re-prioritise any outstanding items affecting the unit's ability to shed heat pursuant to SOP-016. If the unit experiences sustained ambient conditions above the reference thresholds, apply permissible load reductions in accordance with MG-021.
